creator: Alexander Terp
description:
GitHub issue #2 part 7 (0.15.0): Claude Code's folder-trust dialog reads as idle. `muster pane wait --pane <id> --until idle,blocked` returned `idle` while the pane showed "Accessing workspace ... Is this a project you created or one you trust?" with "No, exit" highlighted. A director that waits for idle and then posts lands its brief behind the dialog.

`pane send --key down --enter` answered it, and the next wait correctly said blocked, then idle. 0.15.0 detects Codex's pre-session dialogs as blocked (issue #1 part 3, card a_2die6kvWY); the Claude Code manifest (`crates/muster-detect/manifests/claude.toml`) needs the same for the folder-trust dialog and its other pre-session screens. Record the dialog into `corpus/` so the rule has a transcript to be judged against. Card a_2caDmnukP (a `./dev --claude-code` check that `--key down --enter` passes folder trust) covers the answering side.
title: Claude Code's folder-trust dialog reads as idle
